newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin operation going according to plan - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin operation going according to plan - Kremlin.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation is going according to plan and there have been no complications in the first six hours of surgery, a Kremlin spokesman said on Tuesday.
The spokesman said the Kremlin had received news of the course of surgery at 1 p.m. (1000 GMT). "At that time the operation was going according to plan, there are no complications," he said.
The bypass operation on the 65-year-old Russian president was being carried out by top Russian surgeon Renat Akchurin, assisted by a dozen specialists.
Western doctors, including U.S. heart bypass pioneer Michael DeBakey, were monitoring the surgery.

Yeltsin, who had two heart attacks last year, has said he agreed to have the operation to enable him to live a normal life. He said in a statement issued before the surgery began that he was confident that it would go well.
